meta.name: source-companies
meta.description: Find and import target companies from multiple data sources including Apollo, Clay, Google Maps, HG Insights, Ocean.io, and webhooks. Use when user asks about "find companies", "company list", "data sources", "where to find companies", "import companies", "Google Maps leads", "tech stack targeting", "webhooks", "Triggery". Do NOT use for finding individual contacts (use find-contacts) or ICP definition (use define-icp).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多数据源自动找到目标公司并导入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量获取目标公司信息以用于销售或营销。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically find and import target companies from multiple data sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch acquire target company information for sales or marketing.

howto.what: 帮助你从多个数据源（Apollo、Clay、Google Maps、HG Insights、Ocean.io等）查找和导入目标公司。首选通过ColdIQ（如果配置）快速完成，否则手动指导选择数据源、筛选条件并导入到Clay等工具。
howto.when: 当你提到“找公司”、“公司列表”、“导入公司”、“Google Maps线索”、“技术栈定位”等关键词，或询问数据源时触发。不用于找个人联系人（用find-contacts）或定义ICP（用define-icp）。

say.text: 帮我找一下使用Salesforce的SaaS公司，50-500人。
从Google Maps上找芝加哥的餐厅。
say.note: Claude会建议用Apify抓取并导入CSV到Clay。

say.text: 怎么抓取我LinkedIn帖子下的互动公司？

howto.what_en: Help you find and import target companies from multiple data sources (Apollo, Clay, Google Maps, HG Insights, Ocean.io, etc.). First tries ColdIQ if available, otherwise guides manual selection of sources, filters, and import into Clay.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about 'find companies', 'company list', 'import companies', 'Google Maps leads', 'tech stack targeting', or data sources. Not for individual contacts (use find-contacts) or ICP definition (use define-icp).

say_en.text: Find SaaS companies using Salesforce with 50-500 employees.
say_en.note: Will guide using Sales Navigator and HG Insights, export to Clay.

say_en.text: Find local restaurants in Chicago from Google Maps.
say_en.note: Will suggest Apify scraper and CSV import into Clay.

say_en.text: How to capture companies engaging with my LinkedIn posts?
say_en.note: Will explain setting up Triggery webhook to Clay for auto-capture.
